passages.provision_quote: Section 1. Repeal Section 13-3603, Arizona Revised Statutes, is repealed.
passages.note: Signed chapter law repealing the near-total abortion ban; the repeal itself states no gestational limit.
Bill status page names Stahl Hamilton as prime sponsor of the repeal.
House Third Reading roll call shows her Yea vote on final passage.

rows.reasoning: Stahl Hamilton prime-sponsored HB2677 (2024) and voted Yea on House Third Reading (STAHL HAMILTON Y, Passed 32-28-0-0-0); the bill's operative text only repeals the near-total ban ('Repeal Section 13-3603, Arizona Revised Statutes, is repealed.'). This shows opposition to a total ban with no exceptions but names no gestational limit, so it cannot separate rungs 1 through 4 ('keep abortion legal at every stage' through 'allow abortion during the first trimester... only to protect the mother's health').
needs_source: Any statement or record from Stahl Hamilton tying this repeal vote to a specific gestational-limit position (e.g., a floor speech or press release naming a trimester standard), needed to distinguish rungs 1-4
